interfaces: source-agent policies, navigation, edits, generated files and checks
project views and returned protected-content diagnostics
design.method: Bounded YAML parser events and physical scalar tokens; YAML 1.2 core string resolution; explicit graph-wide alias ownership; private original/encoded scalar context; reparse values, types and topology before publication.
non_goals: No full YAML language or arbitrary object-constructor claim
design.owner: Bamboozle document engine; Vandal only routes existing product interfaces.
requirements: Specify exact selected scalar paths and an explicit supported YAML syntax/version contract; reject ambiguous selections before publication
Preserve unselected keys/values, comments, quoting, tags, anchors/aliases, formatting, BOM and line endings; define alias ownership without implicit edits
Integrate saved contexts, CLI, operator MCP, view policies and returned-edit validation while keeping translation and encryption separate
Execute a complete dependent application using translated, edited and restored YAML configuration, including anchors, multiline values, malformed input and drift/recovery
Retain Python/text/Markdown/JSON behavior and historical contexts; qualify source and isolated installed-package workflows

retained_failures: First application smoke used nonexistent Translator.backward; corrected the qualifier to the existing reverse method. No product API was changed to conceal this failure.

First lint/type review found four style errors and three optional/type annotations in the new adapter, then JSON policy inference and MCP response narrowing errors in qualification code. Corrected and rechecked.
